scope: Existing literal USB contracts with five explicit correctness decisions; all seventeen unequal cases remain outside parity totals.

difference.reason: Pinned C returns the retained GetInfo remainder after VERSION, whereas Rust returns the new VERSION response. Retain explicit outputs; this case is not wire parity.

Pinned C emits retained GetInfo bytes instead of the new command error and advances that source. Rust emits the error and closes the invalid continuation. Keep both literal outputs outside parity totals.
